INIT_WORK.headline: Social Media
INIT_WORK.description: For Avias, a premium kitchenware brand, we worked on the launch campaign for their new AVS Electric Chopper. The campaign began with a curiosity-led teaser where the audience had to guess the product, followed by a giveaway for three winners who guessed it right. After building anticipation, we revealed the product and created a mix of feature-led reels, product carousels, and engaging launch content to highlight its use and convenience. The campaign helped Avias create strong buzz around the product and turned the launch into an interactive, high-engagement moment for the brand.

INIT_WORK.headline: Social Media
INIT_WORK.description: For Sree Mishti Bhog, we executed a store-launch campaign that built anticipation around their opening and highlighted their launch-day deals. The campaign achieved strong organic reach and helped create meaningful buzz for the brand during its opening phase.

INIT_WORK.headline: Fashion Shoot
INIT_WORK.description:
Tissera is an artisanal atelier for men, built around refined craftsmanship, understated style, and timeless detailing. For the brand, we executed a product-focused fashion photoshoot that highlighted the texture, fit, and premium feel of their pieces.

The shoot was designed to feel clean, elegant, and editorial, keeping the clothes as the hero while bringing out the brand's artisanal identity. The final visuals turned out sharp, tasteful, and highly usable across their digital presence, giving Tissera a strong set of brand images for content, promotions, and portfolio-led storytelling.

INIT_WORK.headline:
"Intoxicated"
Launch
INIT_WORK.description: For Tarun Kiron's Intoxicated drop, we created a visual-led campaign that captured the energy of modern celebrations. Positioned around house parties, wedding nights, and Gen Z occasionwear, the campaign included research, styling direction, a full photoshoot, video content, and social media creatives. The final output gave the collection a bold, youthful identity and helped present the drop as statement fashion for party and wedding-ready moments.

INIT_WORK.headline: Wear Your Personality
INIT_WORK.description:
Wear Your Personality | Six By Eleven

For streetwear brand Six By Eleven, we turned the idea of wearing what you love into a campaign about self expression. We conceptualised and delivered five reels featuring distinct characters, each wearing a tee that reflected their personality. The idea was simple: let the clothes tell you who they are.

INIT_WORK.headline: Diwali, After Hours
INIT_WORK.description:
Diwali, After Hours! | Vedhara

For Vedhara, we brought festive dressing into the Diwali party scene. Built around an actual after party, the campaign put the brand's outfits in the middle of the celebration, showing how they fit a night of dressing up and letting loose. A different side of Diwali, with Vedhara dressed for the occasion.
